title: Refuse a chip authorization the issuer has already seen

cases.says: verified authorizations with rising counters are accepted, for each card, and a failed cryptogram is not
a counter equal to or below the last one verified for the card is a replay, even though its cryptogram verifies
a card is its number and its sequence number, so a replacement card with the same number keeps its own counter
the counter is binary, not BCD, so its bytes are read as a number
only a counter whose cryptogram verified is recorded, so a forged high counter does not lock out the genuine card

origin.section: 18.4. A Valid Cryptogram Proves the Card, Not That the Request Is New
